title: Daily puzzle
description: Single source of truth for the file format shared by the Python engine and the TypeScript app. Structural validation only; size- and region-dependent invariants are enforced in code by both languages.

id.description: Puzzle date in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD, with an optional family suffix for a companion puzzle of that day. Also the filename stem. The suffix list is generated from `conformance/id-cases/manifest.json`, which also pins the engine's `Rulebook.id_suffix` and the app's `PUZZLE_TYPE_SUFFIX` to it. Escapes are kept to what both regex flavours accept: ajv compiles patterns with the `u` flag, which rejects a hyphen escaped the Python way.

type.description: Puzzle family. Selects the adapter in the app.

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic PRNG, so any puzzle can be replayed exactly.

generatorVersion.description: Bumped when generation changes in a way that would alter output for a fixed seed. Capped at the JavaScript safe-integer limit: JSON.parse rounds larger values, so the browser would disagree with the engine about which algorithm produced the puzzle.

difficulty.description: Band the board was generated to, 1-based into the engine's LEVEL_NAMES: 1 Easy, 2 Medium, 3 Hard, 4 Expert, 5 Nightmare. The weekly ramp aims each weekday at one band and may fall below it when the seed budget runs out, so this is a floor rather than a promise. Absent from files published before the ramp existed.

board.description: The grid and everything that describes it, nested so the shape belongs to the game rather than the envelope. `size` sat at the top level until this migration, where it meant 'size x size' for one genre and would mean 'size wide' for another; nesting it is what stops a third game inheriting that ambiguity. The star-battle capacity requirement is enforced by the top-level `allOf` below, since `type` is a sibling of `board`, not a member of it.

size.description: Grid is size x size, and the number of regions equals size.

regions.description: Region id per cell, row-major, length exactly size * size.

regionCapacity.description: Queens per region, per region id. Defaults to 1 for every region (the Queens case). Required for star-battle.
